title: Lower CAC with AI-powered paid media for dealers
summary: Guides for dealership lead response, missed-call recovery, BDC workflows, appointment setting, and follow-up measurement.
body_markdown:
## Treat response as an operating system


Revenue leaks rarely come from one bad script. They come from unanswered calls, slow first responses, inconsistent follow-up, unclear ownership, and appointments that are never confirmed. Fixing one channel while leaving the handoffs untouched simply moves the leak.


A revenue-capture system starts with the customer event, assigns an owner, defines the next useful action, and records the outcome. AI can help with coverage and consistency, but managers still need clear escalation rules and a scorecard tied to appointments and sales outcomes.


## Measure movement, not message volume


The useful measures are speed to first meaningful response, contact rate, appointment set rate, show rate, outcome logging, and the time required for a human handoff. Message counts and call duration are diagnostic signals, not the final business result.


Start with one high-friction workflow, capture a baseline, and expand only after the dealership can explain what improved and where exceptions still need people.
